# Welcome {.unnumbered}

[Back to dashboard](../dashboard/lab-dashboard.html){data-preview-source="../../lab-dashboard.qmd"}

This miniature handbook tests a Quarto **book**: several documents share a
sidebar, chapter numbering, cross-references, search and previous/next navigation.
The walkthrough examples are illustrative; the SSH buttons connect to the RCF lab.

## 🔐 SSH to Nodes

{{< include ../shared/_connect-to-nodes.qmd >}}

## Reading the handbook

1. Open [Building a fabric](building-a-fabric.qmd) from this link or the sidebar.
2. Follow its cross-references to [Checking the fabric](checking-the-fabric.qmd).
3. Use the previous/next links at the bottom to move between chapters.
4. Search for **underlay** using the book's search field.

::: {.callout-note}
## Preview check

Open any chapter in acLabs Preview. Quarto builds the whole book and search
index with the selected preview theme; no manual render is needed. See
`../README.md` for browser preview and static build commands.
:::

## What this example uses

- Native Quarto book navigation and theme styling.
- Markdown tables, code samples, callouts and checklists.
- Cross-references between files in the same project.
- The dashboard's six real RCF SSH links, shared through a Quarto include; no
  custom CSS or executable code cells.

`../README.md` describes how to build and preview this book.
